description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ClaimDao's handling of claim expenses in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, including testing methods for saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting claim expenses.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao's claim expense related data access methods, such as save, retrieve, list, and delete operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new ClaimDao instance and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimExpense object to the database and verifies the assigned ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ClaimExpense by its ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ClaimExpenses filtered by request ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests deleting ClaimExpenses associated with a specific claim request ID.
